# Crossplane: Versioned Bucket + RDS + IAM Role

XRD + Composition using `function-patch-and-transform`, targeting the AWS provider family (`provider-aws-s3`, `provider-aws-rds`, `provider-aws-iam`).

## 1. XRD (CompositeResourceDefinition)

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xappstacks.example.platform
spec:
  group: example.platform
  names:
    kind: XAppStack
    plural: xappstacks
  claimNames:
    kind: AppStack
    plural: appstacks
  defaultCompositionRef:
    name: appstack-aws
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              # --- Bucket ---
              bucketName:
                type: string
                description: Globally unique S3 bucket name
              deletionPolicy:
                type: string
                default: Delete
                enum: [Delete, Orphan]
              # --- RDS ---
              instanceClass:
                type: string
                default: db.t3.micro
              allocatedStorageGB:
                type: integer
                default: 20
              storageEncrypted:
                type: boolean
                default: true
              multiAZ:
                type: boolean
                default: false
              dbName:
                type: string
                default: appdb
              # --- IAM ---
              oidcProviderArn:
                type: string
                description: ARN of the cluster OIDC provider for trust policy
              serviceAccountNamespace:
                type: string
                default: app
              serviceAccountName:
                type: string
                default: app-sa
              # --- Network ---
              vpcId:
                type: string
              subnetIds:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: string
            required:
            - bucketName
            - vpcId
            - subnetIds
            - oidcProviderArn
```

## 2. Composition (function-patch-and-transform)

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: appstack-aws
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: example.platform/v1alpha1
    kind: XAppStack
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
  - step: render-resources
    functionRef:
      name: function-patch-and-transform
    input:
      apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Resources
      resources:

      # ---------- S3 Bucket ----------
      - name: bucket
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
          kind: Bucket
          spec:
            forProvider:
              location: us-east-1
              versioning:
                enabled: true
              serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
                rules:
                - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                    sseAlgorithm: AES256
              publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                blockPublicAcls: true
                blockPublicPolicy: true
                ignorePublicAcls: true
                restrictPublicBuckets: true
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy
          toFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy

      # ---------- RDS PostgreSQL ----------
      - name: rds-instance
        base:
          apiVersion: rds.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
          kind: DBInstance
          spec:
            forProvider:
              engine: postgres
              engineVersion: "15.5"
              autoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
              deletionProtection: true
              publiclyAccessible: false
              storageEncrypted: true
              backupRetentionPeriod: 7
              dbInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
              allocatedStorage: 20
            writeConnectionSecretToRef:
              name: app-db-conn
              namespace: crossplane-system
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.instanceClass
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbInstanceClass
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.allocatedStorageGB
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.storageEncrypted
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.storageEncrypted
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.vpcId
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbSubnetGroupName  # if using pre-created subnet group
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy
          toFieldPath: spec.deletionPolicy
        # multiAZ as optional: only applied when true
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.multiAZ
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAZ
          transforms:
          - type: map
            map:
              "true": true
              "false": null   # omit → provider default (single AZ)

      # ---------- IAM Role (OIDC trust) ----------
      - name: iam-role
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
          kind: Role
          spec:
            forProvider:
              assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [{
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Principal": {"AWS": "${oidcArn}"},
                    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
                    "Condition": {
                      "StringEquals": {
                        "${oidcHost}:sub": "system:serviceaccount:${ns}:${sa}",
                        "${oidcHost}:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
                      }
                    }
                  }]
                }
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.oidcProviderArn
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicyDocument
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Format
              fmt: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [{
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Principal": {"Federated": "%s"},
                    "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                    "Condition": {
                      "StringEquals": {
                        "%s:sub": "system:serviceaccount:%s:%s",
                        "%s:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
                      }
                    }
                  }]
                }
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Regexp
              regexp:
                pattern: '^arn:aws:iam::[0-9]+:oidc-provider/(.*)$'
                group: 1
        # note: multi-fmt trust doc — simpler alternative below in "Notes"

      # ---------- IAM Policy (least privilege on bucket) ----------
      - name: iam-policy
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
          kind: Policy
          spec:
            forProvider:
              name: app-assets-bucket-access
              policyDocument: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [{
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
                    "Resource": ["${bucketArn}", "${bucketArn}/*"]
                  }]
                }
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policyDocument
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Format
              fmt: |
                {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow",
                "Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject","s3:ListBucket"],
                "Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::%s","arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"]}]}

      # ---------- Role-Policy Attachment ----------
      - name: role-policy-attachment
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
          kind: RolePolicyAttachment
          spec:
            forProvider:
              roleNameSelector:
                matchControllerRef: true
              policyArnSelector:
                matchControllerRef: true
```

## 3. Example Claim (dev)

```yaml
apiVersion: example.platform/v1alpha1
kind: AppStack
metadata:
  name: app-dev
  namespace: dev
spec:
  bucketName: acme-app-assets-dev
  instanceClass: db.t3.micro
  multiAZ: false
  dbName: appdb
  vpcId: vpc-0abc123
  subnetIds: [subnet-1, subnet-2]
  oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE
  serviceAccountNamespace: app
  serviceAccountName: app-sa
```

## Notes & Caveats

- **Trust policy templating**: The strict `Format` transform can't inject multiple fields into one string; in practice use `function-go-templating` for the trust document, or precompute the full document in a provider like `function-kcl`. The pipeline above shows the intent; the composition patch limits of `function-patch-and-transform` mean multi-variable string assembly requires chained transforms or an external helper function.
- **Deletion protection**: Crossplane `Delete` deletion policy on a deletion-protected RDS instance will fail until `deletionProtection` is disabled — intentional safeguard.
- **DBSubnetGroup**: In production, add a `DBSubnetGroup` managed resource built from `spec.subnetIds` and patch its status name into the DBInstance — omitted here for brevity, flagged as a follow-up.
- **Secrets**: RDS credentials come via `writeConnectionSecretToRef` (never in Git); compose with `provider-kubernetes` ExternalSecretStore for app namespace delivery.
- **Required functions**: `crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform` must be installed in the cluster (`Function` object or Helm install).
